description: Genuine Nikura SDS Section 2.2 text (pdftotext -layout, scoped by sds-section-scope.js) for the P241 equipment-wording check. Only Positivity lists P241 in Section 2.2; the other three print P241 only outside Section 2.2.

cases.name: Nikura Positivity Essential Oil Blend (neat)
cases.section22:
2.2 Label elements

Signal word:        Classification under Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008
Hazard statements:
                    Danger
Supplemental
Information:        H226, Flammable liquid and vapour.
Precautionary       H304, May be fatal if swallowed and enters airways.
statements:         H315, Causes skin irritation.
                    H317, May cause an allergic skin reaction.
                    H319, Causes serious eye irritation.
                    H412, Harmful to aquatic life with long lasting effects.
                    H401, Toxic to aquatic life.

                    EUH208, Contains 1-Octen-3-yl acetate, Carvone, Citral, Citronellal, Dodecanal, Eucalyptol,
                    Geraniol, Geranyl acetate, Nerol, Neryl acetate, Terpinen-4-ol, a-Pinene, beta-Pinene, delta-3-
                    Carene, l-Limonene, p-Mentha-1,8-dien-7-al. May produce an allergic reaction.

                    P210, Keep away from heat, sparks, open flames and hot surfaces. - No smoking.
                    P233, Keep container tightly closed.
                    P240, Ground/bond container and receiving equipment.
                    P241, Use explosion-proof electrical, ventilating and lighting equipment.
                    P242, Use only non-sparking tools.
                    P243, Take precautionary measures against static discharge.
                    P261, Avoid breathing vapour or dust.
                    P264, Wash hands and other contacted skin thoroughly after handling.
                    P272, Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.
                    P273, Avoid release to the environment.
                    P280, Wear protective gloves/eye protection/face protection.
                    P301/310, IF SWALLOWED: Immediately call a POISON CENTER or doctor/physician.
                    P303/361/353, IF ON SKIN (or hair): Remove/take off immediately all contaminated clothing.
                    Rinse skin with water/shower.
                    P305/351/338, IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact
                    lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing.
                    P331, Do not induce vomiting.
                    P333/313, If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/attention.
                    P337/313, If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/attention.
                    P362, Take off contaminated clothing and wash before reuse.
                    P370/378, In case of fire: Use carbon dioxide, dry chemical, foam for extinction.
                    P403/235, Store in a well-ventilated place. Keep cool.
                    P405, Store locked up.
                    P501, Dispose of contents/container to approved disposal site, in accordance with local
                    regulations.

                    Nikura Ltd, Unit 6, Tariff Road, London, N17 0EB
                                                                                                             Page 3 ( 12 )
                                                                                                  Issue date: 15/09/2025
                                                                                                  Version: 4 (15/09/2025)

Product:                                   SAFETY DATA SHEET
Version:
                                      In accordance with REACH Regulation EC No.1907/2006
                 Nikura | Positivity Essential Oil Blend
                 4
